description: Search the official MCP Registry (~65,000 servers) by keyword. Matches name, title and description; ranks servers whose remote endpoint passed a live initialize check first, then by number of tools. Returns name, title, description, remote/package types, health (ok = works without auth, auth = alive but needs auth, fail = unreachable), tool count and a registry link.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. 'finance & crypto', 'databases' (substring match).

transport.description: remote = hosted endpoint, package = installable (npm/pypi/...), any (default).

working_only.description: Only servers whose remote endpoint responded OK or requires auth (default true). Package-only servers are kept unless transport is 'remote'.

name: find_mcp_servers
